Impressive & spacious 5-bedroom detached dormer bungalow on generous corner site, set in popular development 
within walking distance of Crossmolina town.

Set on a generous, beautifully maintained corner site at 25 Deerpark, Crossmolina, this impressive five-bedroom detached dormer bungalow offers an exceptional blend of spacious family living, scenic surroundings and outstanding convenience. 

Beautifully presented throughout, the property enjoys stunning views towards the majestic Nephin Mountain, creating a wonderful backdrop that can be appreciated from the home and gardens.

The gardens wrap around the property, providing ample outdoor space to relax, entertain and enjoy the peaceful setting, while the enclosed rear garden offers privacy and security, complete with a useful workshop shed. To the front, there is generous off-street parking for several vehicles.
Comprising spacious, well-proportioned accommodation, the home has been thoughtfully designed. The welcoming entrance hallway leads to a bright kitchen/dining room, utility room, spacious sitting room with a solid fuel inset stove, WC, five generous bedrooms, including two ground-floor ensuite bedrooms, a bathroom and hot press. The property is beautifully maintained both inside and out and benefits from oil-fired central heating, offering comfort and practicality throughout the year.

Situated adjacent to Crossmolina GAA Club, residents have immediate access to excellent sporting facilities. The property also enjoys easy access to the N59 and is located just 1km from the heart of Crossmolina, allowing for a pleasant walk to the town's excellent range of everyday amenities. Crossmolina offers supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, traditional pubs, a pharmacy, library, schools and a welcoming community atmosphere, making it an ideal place to call home.

The thriving town of Ballina is just 9.9km away, providing an even wider selection of retail outlets, restaurants, cafés, hotels, healthcare facilities, sporting amenities and recreational activities.

The area is renowned for its outstanding natural beauty and wealth of outdoor pursuits. Nephin Mountain and the Wild Nephin National Park provide spectacular hiking and walking trails through some of Ireland's most unspoilt landscapes, while nearby Lough Conn is internationally recognised for its excellent fishing and breathtaking lakeside scenery.

History and heritage can be explored at Enniscoe House and Gardens, while the nearby Lahardane Loop Walk provides peaceful countryside trails with magnificent views. The famous Wild Atlantic Way is within easy reach, leading to the golden beaches of Enniscrone, Ross Beach and Lacken Strand, all perfect for seaside walks, swimming and watersports. 

To the west, Bangor Erris and Belmullet showcase some of Mayo's most dramatic coastal scenery, with rugged cliffs, pristine beaches and the spectacular landscapes of the Erris Peninsula. The Céide Fields and the sea stacks and cliffs of Downpatrick Head are also easily accessible, offering unforgettable Atlantic Ocean views.

Combining generous accommodation, beautiful presentation, exceptional outdoor space and an enviable location in one of North Mayo's most scenic and accessible settings, 25 Deerpark presents a superb opportunity to acquire a quality home.
